en.title: Standard electromagnetic criteria and the transverse Maxwell cone
en.statement: For a nonvanishing leading denominator, the static polynomial remainder characterizes the standard tensor in all regular real directions. The standard dynamical branch fixes each real visible transverse pole mode on the Maxwell cone.

en.title: Three-fermion pole current and real-space Coulomb return
en.statement: The pole current and contact read the mother action and satisfy total-current conservation. The whole-sphere standard static branch gives the single-4π convolution and cancels the squared unit charge at positive physical speed.

en.title: Actual Yukawa witness and Born overlaps
en.statement: The actual three-fermion candidate gives the squared Yukawa matrix element 24/125. On each fixed causal line the actual bottom overlap and the four-leg product are strictly below one at sufficiently high frequency.

claims.title: 三通道静态回路与有序远场平衡
claims.statement: 实际静态读数精确分成原生、反馈、零模三项。有限返回支先去阻尼，再取空间极限，完整系数等于原生系数加反馈与零模的合并系数。

en.title: Three-channel static circuit and ordered far-field balance
en.statement: The static read splits into native, feedback and null contributions. In the finite return branch, taking zero damping before the spatial limit gives the exact sum of the native and combined feedback-null coefficients.

claims.title: 全矩阵 Sylvester 归约、相位消去与截断不变性
claims.statement: 原静态 Noether 矩阵具有同一有限预解权重。创建态范数消去光子回馈的相位。全 Y 静态读数与物理三费米子五腿窗对截断标号不变，共享四阶解析延拓及六阶零极限。

en.title: Full Sylvester matrix, phase cancellation, and cutoff invariance
en.statement: A single finite resolvent weight gives the full static Noether matrix. The created-state norm cancels the photon-feed phase. The full-Y static read and physical three-fermion window are cut invariant, with a common fourth-order regularization and zero sixth-order limit.
